# Locations & Battles

## Academy {#academy}

Located in [Charlottetown](../codex/places.md#charlottetown) near a quiet neighborhood, the Academy is an educational institution where students are organized into classes to pursue teacher's licenses, compete for medals and scholarships, and engage in their studies.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXXIV. A Queen’s Girl P7](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0007), [v1 CHAPTER XXXIV. A Queen’s Girl P8](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0008), [v1 CHAPTER XXXIV. A Queen’s Girl P9](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0009), [v1 CHAPTER XXXIV. A Queen’s Girl P10](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0010), +28 more_

**Associated with:** [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Moody Spurgeon MacPherson](../character/moody-spurgeon-macpherson.md), [Ruby Gillis](../character/ruby-gillis.md)

## Avenue {#avenue}

The Avenue is a four- or five-hundred-yard stretch of road leading to [Newbridge](../codex/places.md#newbridge), lined with old apple trees whose canopy creates a snowy, fragrant tunnel of bloom.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER II. Matthew Cuthbert Is Surprised P40](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0040), [v1 CHAPTER II. Matthew Cuthbert Is Surprised P41](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0041), [v1 CHAPTER II. Matthew Cuthbert Is Surprised P42](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0042), [v1 CHAPTER II. Matthew Cuthbert Is Surprised P43](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0043), +23 more_

## Avonlea {#avonlea}

Avonlea is the hometown of a group of young scholars who left to attend the Queen's [Academy](../codex/places.md#academy).

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXXIV. A Queen’s Girl P1](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0001), [v1 CHAPTER XXXIV. A Queen’s Girl P2](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0002), [v1 CHAPTER XXXIV. A Queen’s Girl P3](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0003), [v1 CHAPTER XXXIV. A Queen’s Girl P4](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0004), +42 more_

**Associated with:** [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Bentley](../character/bentley.md), [Josie Pye](../character/josie-pye.md), [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), [Stacy](../character/stacy.md)

> During a party, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) accepts Josie Pye's dare to walk the ridgepole of Mr. Barry's roof, resulting in a fall that breaks her ankle. [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) realizes how deeply she cares for [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) as the injured girl is brought home, and during her weeks of recovery, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) enjoys visits from friends while eagerly anticipating returning to school under their new teacher, Miss [Stacy](../character/stacy.md).
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XXIII. Anne Comes to Grief in an Affair of Honor

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXIII. Anne Comes to Grief in an Affair of Honor P15](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0015), [v1 CHAPTER XXIII. Anne Comes to Grief in an Affair of Honor P24](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0024), [v1 CHAPTER XXIII. Anne Comes to Grief in an Affair of Honor P30](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0030), [v1 CHAPTER XXIII. Anne Comes to Grief in an Affair of Honor P41](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0041)_

> [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) realizes that Anne's plain clothes set her apart from other girls, so he decides to buy her a fashionable dress for Christmas. After an awkward attempt to shop at Lawson's store, he gets Mrs. Rachel [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) to buy and sew a brown dress with puffed sleeves for her. On Christmas morning, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) is overjoyed to receive the dress from [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md), along with slippers sent by [Aunt Josephine](../character/josephine-barry.md), and she goes on to star in the successful evening concert.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XXV. Matthew Insists on Puffed Sleeves

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXV. Matthew Insists on Puffed Sleeves P2](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0002), [v1 CHAPTER XXV. Matthew Insists on Puffed Sleeves P47](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0047)_

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and her friends reenact Tennyson's Elaine on a leaky flatboat, forcing [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to cling to a bridge pile until [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) rescues her. When Gilbert apologizes and asks to be friends, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) refuses, though she later reflects on her foolishness with [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md).
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XXVIII. An Unfortunate Lily Maid

## Birch Path {#birch-path}

Named by [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md), the Birch Path is a picturesque, narrow, and spicy-aired pathway fringed with young birches and wildflowers that winds through Mr. Bell's woods on the route to the [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) school.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XIV. Anne’s Confession P70](../source/v01-c14.md#nw-v01-c14-p0070), [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P0](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0000), [v1 CHAPTER XV. ## Bolingbroke {#bolingbroke}

Bolingbroke is a place in [Nova Scotia](../codex/places.md#nova-scotia) where [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) was born, featuring a high school where her parents taught and a small yellow house where her family lived before she became an orphan.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER V. Anne’s History P7](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0007), [v1 CHAPTER V. Anne’s History P8](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0008), [v1 CHAPTER V. **Associated with:** [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md)

## Bright River {#bright-river}

Bright River is a location reachable by an eight-mile drive from [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) Cuthbert's home, featuring a train station house with a long platform and ladies' waiting room, as well as a small local hotel.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER I. Mrs. Rachel Lynde Is Surprised P12](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0012), [v1 CHAPTER I. Mrs. Rachel Lynde Is Surprised P15](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0015), +26 more_

> [Matthew Cuthbert](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) travels to Bright River to pick up an expected orphan boy, only to discover that a talkative eleven-year-old girl has been sent instead. Deciding to let [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) handle the mistake, [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) invites the girl into his buggy and listens as she excitedly chats about her imagination and life experiences during the drive.
>

## Green Gables {#green-gables}

Green Gables is the secluded, meticulously kept homestead of [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) and [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), situated at the edge of their cleared land in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea), reachable by a long, rose-bordered lane, and featuring an orchard-embowered house and a very neat yard.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER I. Mrs. Rachel Lynde Is Surprised P0](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0000), [v1 CHAPTER I. Mrs. Rachel Lynde Is Surprised P1](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0001), [v1 CHAPTER I. Mrs. Rachel Lynde Is Surprised P2](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0002), [v1 CHAPTER I. Mrs. Rachel Lynde Is Surprised P3](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0003), +11 more_

**Associated with:** [Anne of Green Gables](../character/anne-of-green-gables.md), [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Matthew Cuthbert](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md)

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) wakes up at Green Gables and admires the scenery from her window before being called down to breakfast by [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md). After a quiet meal with [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md), [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) helps with chores while reflecting on her uncertain future. [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) prepares to drive [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to [White Sands](../codex/places.md#white-sands-hotel) to meet Mrs. [Spencer](../character/alexander-spencer.md), while [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) quietly signals his desire to keep [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md).
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER IV. Morning at Green Gables

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER IV. Morning at Green Gables P0](../source/v01-c04.md#nw-v01-c04-p0000), [v1 CHAPTER IV. Morning at Green Gables P19](../source/v01-c04.md#nw-v01-c04-p0019), [v1 CHAPTER IV. > [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) instructs [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) on tidiness and is shocked to discover that [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) has never said prayers before. After asking [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to pray in her own words, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) hears [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) deliver an unconventional prayer expressing her desires and gratitude. Afterwards, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) discusses Anne's spiritual ignorance with [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) and resolves to begin her religious education immediately.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER VII. Anne Says Her Prayers

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER VII. Anne Says Her Prayers P3](../source/v01-c07.md#nw-v01-c07-p0003), [v1 CHAPTER VII. Anne Says Her Prayers P4](../source/v01-c07.md#nw-v01-c07-p0004), [v1 CHAPTER VII. > After [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) scolds [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) for her decorated church hat, she takes [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to [Orchard Slope](../codex/places.md#orchard-slope) to meet [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md). The two girls quickly become best friends and swear a solemn oath of friendship. Returning home to Green Gables, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) excitedly tells [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) about [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md), and [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) gives [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) a treat of chocolates.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XII. A Solemn Vow and Promise

> [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) accuses [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) of losing her amethyst brooch and confines her to her room until she confesses. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) concocts a false confession in hopes of attending the picnic, but [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) forbids her from going anyway. Soon after, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) discovers the brooch caught in her shawl, realizes her mistake, and happily sends [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) off to enjoy the picnic after all.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XIV. Anne’s Confession

## Lover’s Lane {#lover-s-lane}

## Orchard Slope {#orchard-slope}

> After speaking with Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) goes to Orchard Slope to apologize directly to [Aunt Josephine](../character/josephine-barry.md) [Barry](../character/josephine-barry.md) for jumping onto her bed. Anne's honest confession and imaginative defense amuse Miss [Barry](../character/josephine-barry.md), convincing her to forgive [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) and stay in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea). Miss [Barry](../character/josephine-barry.md) and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) become good friends throughout the rest of her visit.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XIX. A Concert, a Catastrophe, and a Confession
